title: Blackjack
subtitle: Monte Carlo Exploring Starts
overview: A classic card game where the goal is to beat the dealer by getting a hand value as close to 21 as possible without going over.
rules: Cards 2-10 are worth their face value
Face cards (J, Q, K) are worth 10
Aces are worth 1 or 11 (whichever is better)
Dealer must hit on 16, stand on 17

algorithm.name: Monte Carlo Exploring Starts
algorithm.description: The AI learns optimal play by simulating hundreds of thousands of games and tracking which actions lead to wins in each situation.

mathematics.stateSpace: 200 unique states (player total × dealer card × usable ace)

keyInsight: The learned policy matches the mathematically proven optimal basic strategy, demonstrating that reinforcement learning can discover optimal solutions through pure experience.
